title: OPite
description: an old mod i made back in 2021 using mcreator and originally uploaded to CurseForge but decided to upload here as well
body:
an old mod i made back in 2021 using mcreator and originally uploaded to CurseForge but decided to upload here as well

i don't have the source for it anymore so it sadly can't be updated to newer versions.

description from the original mod post is below.

"Adds a new resource called OPite.

Features

+OPite ore

+OPite Sword, tools, and Armor

+5 new advancements

+OPite block

+A new Mob called the OP Creepr

You'll need a Netherite pickaxe to mine OPite.

You can find OPite from Y=20 to Y=1 in groups of up to 4



This is my first mod, made with MCreator

Sorry if it isn't that good, I just made something simple.

I hope you enjoy the mod!







(This mod is for Forge ONLY. Maybe I'll figure out how to make a version for Fabric.)"
